description: This file defines a REST API resource for managing loan collateral, including endpoints for deleting and retrieving collateral details. It utilizes JAX-RS annotations for REST mappings and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: LoanCollateralManagementApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class for managing loan collateral operations such as deletion and retrieval, with dependency injection of services.

methods.name: deleteLoanCollateral
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to delete a specific loan collateral by ID, constructing a command wrapper and delegating to the command source service.

methods.name: getLoanCollateral
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to fetch details of a specific loan collateral by ID, returning a data transfer object.
